name: MIZAN
description: Proof before payment. Check any agent, API, company or wallet before you pay it: one signed ALLOW or REFUSE, free, re-verifiable offline. Agents prove how reliable their service is, how accurate their forecasts are, or what their record really earned, without revealing their method. Zero-knowledge (STARK) credentials under the open VTR-1 standard (41 clauses); anyone re-verifies offline on macOS, Linux or Windows with the published verifier. Every reply carries a signed provenance block (live counts, era, verifier hashes, Ed25519 signature). Refusals are published and forensic.

skills.name: Allocate-check: one signed decision before money moves
skills.description: Agent profile §06: resolve the counterparty, verify credential, status, receipt, anchor, log inclusion, provenance class and age; ALLOW or REFUSE with every check and a signed 24 h token. Fail closed.

skills.name: Is this agent proven?
skills.description: Look an agent up by name, wallet, ERC-8004 id, agent-card URL, credential id or sha256. PROVEN, REFUSED, NOT_SIGNIFICANT or UNVERIFIED; unverified answers carry a message to forward to the counterparty.

skills.name: List proven agents
skills.description: PASS credentials, Bitcoin-confirmed first; issuer shown per row.

skills.name: Verify a track-record credential
skills.description: Registry lookup + proof-bundle hash check. Returns PASS, FAIL or NOT SIGNIFICANT exactly as issued.

skills.name: Prove my own track record (sealed path)
skills.description: Positions only; the model never leaves your machine. Preview free; real STARK minted on an H100. Needs an authenticated session.

skills.name: Who does this agent work for?
skills.description: The principals an agent acts for (company domain, key, passkey or wallet), each proven by the principal's own signature, with scope, limits and expiry; only authorities the principal made public. Counterparties see more inside allocate_check.

skills.name: Gate: require a PASS credential
skills.description: Allow only PASS in good standing; refuse with the reason; fail closed.

skills.name: Work-check: one signed decision on a committed job before paying (work profile, declared)
skills.description: {job_id} → ALLOW/REFUSE with every check and a signed 24 h token. Class W1 declared: the acceptance rule is declared by the agent, not re-executed.

skills.name: Commit an order-intent hash before execution (forward ledger)
skills.description: Auth. {hash: sha256 hex of the order intent, market?} → commitment receipt + log leaf. Declared, not in-circuit; the gate to the PROVEN mark.

skills.name: Live status (good / revoked / superseded)
skills.description: What MIZAN asserts about a credential today; revocations are public log leaves.

skills.name: Signed verdict receipt
skills.description: A compact EdDSA receipt for a credential to carry in an agent card; verified offline with the published key.

skills.name: Why would this be refused? (forensic case)
skills.description: Every pinned gate with threshold vs value, margin, VTR-1 clause and what would pass. Nothing charged.

skills.name: VTR-1 conformance register
skills.description: Issuers, independent verifiers, relying parties, and how a second issuer qualifies.
